name: Shichigahama (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Shichigahama town emblem in white: a broken ring enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Shichigahama, a town in Miyagi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1959.

features.role: Shichigahama town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised character
